classes.name: Spellblade
classes.description: A warrior who combines martial prowess with arcane magic, striking foes with enchanted blades and devastating spells.

abilities.name: Fire Strike
abilities.description: Imbue your weapon with flames and strike your enemy, dealing physical and fire damage.

effects.attack_description: You channel flames into your weapon and strike for ${damage} damage!

abilities.name: Combo Strike
abilities.description: Execute a rapid series of strikes, hitting your enemy multiple times in quick succession.

effects.attack_description: You unleash ${name} in a flurry of blows, dealing ${damage} damage!

abilities.name: Vampiric Blade
abilities.description: A dark strike that damages your enemy and heals you for a portion of the damage dealt. Also grants passive lifesteal.

effects.attack_description: Your weapon pulses with dark energy, dealing ${damage} damage!
You drain life force, restoring ${damage} health!
